title: Practice: Before, above, with, without, half, very

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does со- add in собесе́дник (“speaking partner, other person (with whom one is talking), interlocutor”)?
options: place or manner of an action
shared participation in something, or shared belonging
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists собесе́дник under this meaning of со-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «со-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/со-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in оста́ток (“remainder, rest, residue, remnant”)?
options: turning into something, giving it particular properties
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists оста́ток under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 8 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in оку́рок (“cigarette butt, cigar butt”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists оку́рок under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 8 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: suburb, outskirts, faubourg (an outlying part of a city or town)
speaking partner, other person (with whom one is talking), interlocutor
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: предме́стье — suburb, outskirts, faubourg (an outlying part of a city or town); председа́тель — chairman, president; на́дпись — inscription, writing, label; собесе́дник — speaking partner, other person (with whom one is talking), interlocutor.

exercises.q: What does про- add in промежу́ток (“gap, interval, period, space, stretch, span (a distance in space)”)?
options: an action lasting for a certain stretch of time
completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists промежу́ток under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 8 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: безопа́сный — safe, secure; безопа́сность — safety; бесконе́чный — endless, infinite, unlimited, boundless; бестолко́вый — muddle-headed, stupid.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: полукру́г — semicircle; полуго́лый — half-naked; прему́дрый — (very) wise; sage; прехоро́шенький — very good, very pretty.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прекра́сный — beautiful; сверхъесте́ственный — supernatural; оста́ток — remainder, rest, residue, remnant; оку́рок — cigarette butt, cigar butt.
